jobs.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction / identity-preserve. Production-ready game sprite of the APPROVED 创智龙 robot statue from reference image 1. This is the SAME approved character, not a redesign.
Output ONE completely isolated full-body robot on its LOW ROUND cream stone plinth, transparent RGBA background. No environment, no scenic backdrop, no plants, no small companion, no captions, no white rectangle, no cast shadow outside the base. Square canvas with the whole figure and plinth centered and occupying about 90% of height. Leave small transparent padding around horns and tail.
Identity invariants: exact original branching cobalt horns, thick scalloped blue cloud mane, round white head, pale blue goggles rim around a flat full-face pale screen, the same expressive large blue eyes/nose/smile as original mascot displayed on that screen, round side ears/housings, ivory hoodie-shaped mechanical torso with two dark drawstring-shaped insets and small cyan chest light, cobalt shorts-shaped hip shell, short white mechanical limbs and blue joints, white broad shoes with blue soles, short curled segmented white tail ending in amber flame. About 2.1 heads tall, familiar mascot silhouette. Do not substitute a generic screen-headed machine or a human. No armor, no halo, no gears, no gold.
POSE AND VIEW FOR PLACEMENT: upper-right corner of plaza, so robot's face and front torso point gently toward SCREEN LEFT (towards center of plaza). We see its front and RIGHT side in a 3/4 elevated 2.5D game view, viewed from above about 15 degrees. Raised open hand extends towards SCREEN LEFT; tail and amber flame curve on SCREEN RIGHT. Feet planted on a low cream circular plinth. Plinth top is a broad horizontal ellipse with a shallow front wall, no steps. Simple calm standing pose, no motion streaks. The plinth is only 15% wider than the stance plus tail silhouette.
Lighting from upper left. Screen face very pale ice-blue, clean cyan eyes. Original design faithfully preserved.
Render as crisp clean softly hand-painted classic game art, matching approved artwork: matte ivory shell, clear cobalt shapes, clean mechanical seams, moderate shading, no rough grain, no photorealistic toy reflections. This is an actual transparent sprite asset, not a design board.
